skill.name: Avengerang
skill.description: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals damage going out and coming back, extending its range each time it hits an enemy.

skill.name: Power Fist
skill.description: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make the next attack deal double damage and pop their target up in the air.

skill.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
skill.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.
